integrity.claim_basis: Analytic single-crossing proof for independent bond percolation on two finite tree topologies; exact finite checks supply reproducibility but not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous independent bond retention with a uniformly selected source on a fixed finite star or path.
Threshold refers to ultimate component size, not incidence peak or ordinary SIR models with correlated transmission.
No claim of general-tree topology optimality or independent scientific certification.
Close first-and-second-moment work on these precise graph models is prior art; its inaccessible full text leaves a residual bibliography risk.

title: A sharp topology-dependent reversal of finite outbreak-tail risk
